test_title: SSC CPO 2022 Tier-II Official Paper (Held On: 02 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Direction: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in indirect speech.**

Mrs. Gomes said, “Virtue is its own reward.”

options.text: Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue was its own reward
Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue is its own reward.
Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue had its own reward.
Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue has its own reward.

solution:
The correct answer is** "Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue is its own reward."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__ 

 
• The rules for changing Direct Speech to Indirect Speech:
 
• The given sentence is in the Present Simple Tense.
 
• The statement **"Virtue is its own reward"** is a universal truth.
 
• In indirect speech, the word “that” is used when commas and inverted commas are removed.
 
• We don’t make any changes in the sentence with universal truth in indirect speech.
 
• Example: 
 
 
• *He said, “Earth is a planet”(Direct speech)*
 
• *He said that Earth is a planet. (Indirect speech)*
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is Option 2.

 

Correct sentence: *Mrs. Gomes said that Virtue is its own reward*.
